gst_warnings.invalid_customer_gstin: {{label}}: the customer's GSTIN is not valid, so this bill is reported as B2C. Correct the GSTIN on the customer.

gst_warnings.hsn_too_short: {{label}}: the HSN code needs more digits for your turnover.
gst_warnings.invalid_place_of_supply: {{label}}: place of supply is not a valid state code.
gst_warnings.invalid_gst_rate: {{label}}: the GST rate is not a valid GST slab.
gst_warnings.credit_note_without_invoice: {{label}}: credit note is not linked to an original bill.
gst_warnings.business_gstin_missing: Your business GSTIN is not set. Add it in business settings before filing.
gst_warnings.missing_purchase_gstin: {{label}}: input tax claimed but the supplier has no GSTIN.
